news_headlines.title: Pentagon awards Microsoft $9.7B deal to consolidate software licenses across military branches
news_headlines.summary: The US Department of Defense has awarded Dell Federal Systems a five-year, $9.7 billion contract to consolidate Microsoft software licensing across the military, intelligence community, and Coast Guard. This Core Enterprise Technology Agreement (CETA) aims to eliminate duplicate purchases and generate $422 million in annual savings. Dell will manage the logistics and compliance, while Microsoft provides the software, highlighting Microsoft's continued dominance in government IT.

(NASDAQ: OESX) has launched a new energy-efficient LED lighting solution, the MPHL2, specifically targeting the rapidly growing AI-driven data center market. The company plans to build a fleet of approximately 150,000 GPU units and has secured over 4.5 GW of renewable power capacity for its data centers.
